title: forwardable identity refresh result
description: Forwardable members of the enterprise identity refresh --json result (private #10, from 1.0.6): counts and codes only; changes[] (account ids and profiles) stays on the device. Forward schema (private #14 option A): the members a management agent may send off the device. Project with allowlist-and-drop (forward/project.py): a member not listed here, or a value outside its pattern or enum, is removed, never rejected, so members a newer DefenseClaw adds are not forwarded until this file lists them. Only DefenseClaw-minted ids, bundle and receipt ids, digests, counts, codes, booleans, enums, versions and times pass; account names and identifiers (user, uid, SID, UPN, group), paths and messages never do.
